title: Keep card interchange fees within the RBA's caps
what: Interchange fees in designated credit card schemes must not exceed the RBA's caps (0.300 per cent of the value of a consumer credit card transaction).

laws.title: Standard No. 1 of 2016 The Setting of Interchange Fees in the Designated Credit Card Schemes and Net Payments to Issuers

assessment.summary: Interchange fees in designated credit card schemes must not exceed the RBA's caps (0.300 per cent of the value of a consumer credit card transaction).

marks.reason: Caps set the price card issuers charge for each transaction.
Lower interchange cuts merchants' costs of accepting cards.
